summary:
Implementation plan for:
1. Lagoon-style radial menu covering everything except gizmo and side panel, with toggle button before Projection [F8] button and shortcut/gesture toggle.
2. Fixing camera viewpoint options (Front, Back, Right, Left, Top, Bottom, Ortho/Persp) in the View Menu.
3. Adding a 'Disabled / Uncapped' refresh rate toggle in Preferences.
4. Comprehensive API_DOCUMENTATION.md for Viewport, Brush, Layers, Filters, WebGL/DirectX/OpenGL ANGLE architecture, and Shader Nodes.
5. DEVELOPMENT.md documenting program architecture, genesis of Rust and Self-Hosted apps, and engine handover guidelines.
6. Updating AGENTS.md with cross-references to all documentation files and transfer recommendations.
